biotools.summary: NanoCore is a user-friendly software for Nanopore-based genomic surveillance that enables the calculation and visualization of core-genome multilocus sequence typing (cgMLST) sample distances directly from unassembled Nanopore reads. It supports Illumina data analysis as well and is available as free software via conda.
